key_concepts: A force is a push or pull caused by an interaction between two objects.
Forces may be contact forces or action-at-a-distance forces.
Newton’s third law states that for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction.
Forces always occur in action-reaction pairs acting on two interacting objects.
Action and reaction forces are equal in size and opposite in direction.
Action-reaction forces do not cancel because they act on different bodies.
Fish swim because water pushes fish forward as fish push water backward.
Birds fly because air pushes bird upward as wings push air downward.
Cars move because road pushes wheels forward as wheels push road backward.
Rockets can accelerate in space because exhaust gases push back on the rocket.
